description: What does a correlated scalar subquery in the select list give over JA (Null key row, key 1 with two JB matches) for Count(*), Count(column), Max over Text, Sum, TOP 1 with ORDER BY both ways, First and Last, a child returning two rows, a child correlated through a second nesting level, an uncorrelated child, the same child in ORDER BY, WHERE, GROUP BY (grouped column only) and HAVING? Runs on a fresh copy of r-sql-13b-main (ACCDB) opened read-only through ACE DAO; each text is opened as a snapshot with Database.OpenRecordset, Fields Name/Type/Size are read before the first row, then every row's Field values to EOF (each MoveNext captured), then Close and DBEngine.Errors.
retentionNote: Designed r-sql-13b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
